english.meaning: citizenship; legal membership of a nation
english.note: This is the all-purpose noun for legal nationality or citizenship.
This is the all-purpose everyday choice when citizenship means the country a person legally belongs to.

examples.english: When you fill in the form, you need to write your nationality.
